name: Zenith Dragoon Rising
name_jp: 究極リベリオンダイブ
effects: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] to the user if entry damage was Wind/Lightning/Water/Dark, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Ricard (Wind, Lightning, Water, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] to the user if entry damage was Wind/Lightning/Water/Dark, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Ricard (Wind, Lightning, Water, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Ricard (Wind, Lightning, Water, Dark)
description.text: Increases [Lightning/Wind/Water/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, casting speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, casts Spirit Attack: Ricard (Lightning, Wind, Water, Dark) after using a Dragoon ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Pride of Deist+
description.text: Six single ranged jump attacks (1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Will of the Dragoon+
description.text: Four single ranged jump attacks (1.10 each), grants [Jump Instant Cast] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Ricard (Lightning, Wind, Water, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Dragoon Dualcast 1], [Dragoon +30% Boost 1], [Dragoon Instant Cast 1], [No Air Time 1] to all allies if 4+ Dragoon members alive, Grants [Dragoon Dualcast 1], [Dragoon +30% Boost 1], [Dragoon Instant Cast 1] to the user if 0-3 Dragoon members alive

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
